public_home.hero_kicker: Modular operations platform for logistics, delivery, commerce and service teams.
public_home.hero_lead: Ophyra App gives operations-heavy businesses one modular platform to control clients, teams, orders, contracts, inventory, store operations, delivery, tracking and fulfillment without stitching the business together manually.
public_home.hero_micro: Start with the operational core. Add only the modules your business needs next.
public_home.operational_core_desc: Start with CRM, Clients, Team, Basic Payroll, Orders, Contracts, E-signature, Basic Chat, Business Profile and Dashboard.
public_home.less_disconnected_work_desc: Replace scattered WhatsApp threads, spreadsheets, emails, payment links, inventory sheets and manual follow-ups.
public_home.grow_by_modules_desc: Add Advanced Storage, Store + Logistics, AI Advisor or Ticket Sales + RSVP only when your business needs them.
public_home.business_type_subtitle: Ophyra is not only a list of tools. It is an operating base for businesses that need to keep clients, orders, team work, inventory, fulfillment and delivery from spreading across too many places.
public_home.module_path_subtitle: Ophyra grows in three levels: start with a free public business profile, activate the operating core your business needs, then add specialized modules only when the workflow is ready.
public_home.ophyra_base_profile_desc: Create the basic public business profile and limited workspace for free.
public_home.service_operations_desc: Manage CRM, clients, service orders, contracts, team, payroll basics, communications and reports.
public_home.store_logistics_desc: Sell products, manage orders, fulfillment, delivery status, tracking, basic inventory and reports.
public_home.advanced_storage_desc: Track containers, items, storage locations, QR labels and equipment/rental movement.
public_home.ai_advisor_desc: Generate ideas, summarize operations, suggest actions and support business decisions.
public_home.ticket_sales_rsvp_desc: Activate registration, attendance, RSVP and ticketing workflows.
public_home.marketplace_connectors_desc: Connect Mercado Libre, TikTok Business / Shop and Shopify tokens, record manual syncs and map external order statuses into Ophyra.
public_home.custom_domain_seo_desc: Future layer for custom domain setup and stronger public profile pages.
public_home.tool_sprawl_lead: Chat apps, spreadsheets, task boards, calendars, inboxes and shared drives are useful. The problem starts when they become the operating system. Ophyra gives the business one modular base for clients, team, orders, contracts and daily execution.
public_home.scattered_work_label: Scattered work usually looks like this
public_home.one_operating_base: One operating base underneath the tools
public_home.leak_leads: Leads live in messages with no clean follow-up.
public_home.leak_orders: Orders, store activity or delivery updates are tracked by hand.
public_home.leak_team: Team responsibilities are repeated across disconnected chats.
public_home.leak_contracts: Contracts, approvals and files stay buried across inboxes.
public_home.centralize_core: Start with CRM, Clients, Team, Orders and Contracts.
public_home.centralize_storage: Add Advanced Storage / QR Inventory when physical operations matter.
public_home.centralize_store: Add Store + Logistics when fulfillment grows.
public_home.centralize_ai: Add AI Advisor or Ticket Sales + RSVP only when needed.
public_home.tool_sprawl_note: Ophyra does not need to replace every app your team already uses. It gives those workflows a shared operational record so the business can see what is active, assigned, approved, paid and ready to move.
public_home.leak_money_title: Disconnected tools are where operations start leaking money.
public_home.leak_money_text: A business can look busy and still be losing control. Leads sit in messages. Orders live in spreadsheets. Contracts get buried in email. Inventory is tracked separately. Delivery updates are manual. Ophyra exists to bring the operation back into one system.
public_home.core_section_text: Ophyra Base Profile creates the public business profile and limited workspace for free. Paid operational depth begins when the business activates Service Operations, Store + Logistics, or both.
public_home.crm_clients_desc: Track leads, client records, follow-ups, notes and the path from first inquiry to active customer.
public_home.orders_contracts_desc: Connect jobs, services, approvals, contracts, signatures, files and payment visibility to the real workflow.
public_home.team_chat_payroll_desc: Coordinate responsibilities, internal communication, hours and basic payroll inside the same operating base.
public_home.add_modules_title: Add only the modules your business
public_home.add_modules_text: Not every business needs inventory, delivery, AI or ticketing on day one. Ophyra starts with the core, then lets the operation grow by activating paid modules when they make sense.
public_home.start_clean_desc: Start with the free Ophyra workspace and give your business a real operating foundation.
public_home.activate_by_need_desc: Turn on add-ons when the business starts managing stock, store orders, delivery, tracking, events or deeper decision support.
public_home.billing_rhythm_desc: Ophyra is monthly-first, with add-ons designed to align to the main subscription cycle.
public_home.plan_model_text: Ophyra is not an endless catalog of tools. Start with the free Base Profile, activate one or both operating cores, then add optional modules only when the workflow is ready.
public_home.step_base_text: Create the public business profile and limited starter workspace for free.
public_home.step_core_text: Select Service Operations for service work or Store + Logistics for commerce and fulfillment.
public_home.step_combine_text: If the business needs both service execution and product fulfillment, activate both modules separately.
public_home.step_add_text: Turn on Advanced Storage, AI Advisor or Ticket Sales + RSVP only when that layer is useful.
public_home.step_public_text: Custom Domain + SEO Page Builder stays marked Coming Soon until pricing and scope are ready.
public_home.built_for_move_title: Built for businesses where operations actually move.
public_home.built_for_move_text: Ophyra is not only for planners, venues or vendors. It is for businesses that manage clients, teams, orders, inventory, delivery, fulfillment or daily operational workflows.
public_home.pricing_highlight: Activate only the system you need.
public_home.pricing_subtitle: Create your public business profile for free, then unlock Service Operations, Store + Logistics, AI, ticketing, storage, marketplace connectors or SEO tools as your business grows.

public_home.referral_growth_text: Referral growth should support the product story: better operations for service, commerce and fulfillment businesses.

public_home.testimonial_2: "It made us look more professional fast. Clients feel the difference when your process is clean."

dashboard_home.level1_hero_title: Choose the right operating nucleus before touching the work.
dashboard_home.level1_hero_text: Ophyra controls the platform. VNV Events runs event operations. Avomeal runs food, store, fulfillment and delivery. Each area keeps its own metrics, customers and operational context visible.
dashboard_home.ophyra_platform_text: Manage businesses, memberships, modules, billing, platform CMS and global system activity without treating operational customers as Ophyra clients.
dashboard_home.vnv_events_text: Manage event orders, clients, team, contracts, tickets, AI insights, upcoming events and service execution in one operational workspace.
dashboard_home.avomeal_text: Manage products, online orders, fulfillment, delivery, customers and store performance with Avomeal identity and owner scope.

dashboard_home.level2_hero_title: Start with your free Base Profile, then activate the modules your business needs.
dashboard_home.level2_hero_text: Base Profile gives your business a public identity and a limited workspace. CRM, orders, team, store, AI and ticketing stay locked until activation or payment.
dashboard_home.level2_architecture_title: Run your business workspace from the right operating core.
dashboard_home.level2_architecture_text: Base Profile keeps your public identity active. Service Operations and Store + Logistics unlock the real work, while shared tools adapt to the active core.
